title: Frog Blast
summary: Drop bombs, blast through crates and outsmart rival frogs.
description:
A classic garden bomb arena with chain reactions and collectible upgrades.

Play solo against bots or challenge a friend on the same keyboard. First to three round wins takes the match.
controls: Player 1: WASD and Space. Player 2: arrow keys and Enter. Mobile: directional pad and bomb button. P or Escape pauses.
